pair_order: off,on for even query positions; on,off for odd; same in both rounds
metrics: Span Recall over complete exact gold quotes; chunk MRR/nDCG uses frozen actual chunk IDs/grades. All planned requests retained; failure/degradation gets zero strict quality. Report answerable-only secondary and no-answer separately.
warm_interpretation: Every CE score starts a new process and loads weights. Second round is OS-cache warm, not resident CE inference.
decision: Keep default off unless all gates pass; a pass only makes this synthetic configuration eligible for operator review. No production SLA, diagnosis accuracy or calibrated abstention claim.
acceptance_rule: Run dev first. Freeze source/plan before acceptance. Never change acceptance queries, labels, retrieval budgets or gates after observing acceptance. Any bug retry gets a new source freeze/output; retain earlier attempts.
